title: My Phone Recorded Me Sleeping. I Wasn't Alone #shorts #horror
description: I found a voice note on my phone from 3:12 AM. I was asleep. Someone else was talking. #shorts #horror #scary #creepy #horrorstory

hook.text: Someone whispered my name while I slept.

lines.text: I found a voice note on my phone. Recorded at 3:12 AM.
I was asleep. Alone. Doors locked.
At first, just my breathing. Then footsteps.
Then a voice, right next to the bed, whispered my name.
It said: she sleeps so deeply.
Last night I hit record again. It's 3:11.
